details:
I've got the strangest problem and I'd really appreciate it if anyone could help.  since the last big update on 1.1.22 my 3.0 avatar is broken in most worlds.  he freezes and glitches and stutters to everyone but me.  To me he is absolutely normal.  I can walk around, use my toggles etc but to other users he is usually frozen and glitching at the spawn point.  The other bizarre thing is that he works perfectly (as in everyone can see him just fine) in Midnight Rooftop and a few other less popular worlds.  I'm wondering if anyone has any idea what might be going on.  Also, the earlier versions of this model work fine and one other weird thing is that if i change into any other random avatar after wearing my broke version, that random avatar becomes broken as well.  i have to go to midnight rooftop to change and then everything is fine.  thanks in advance for any help you can give. 
Someone on the VRChat discord said that there's currently a bug where avatars with seats will cause worsening IK issues and that i should remove the seats.  Unfortunately, i have a prob with that.  the guy that made the avatar for me has disappeared and i dont have the project.  do you think theres any chance this issue will be fixed or am i out of luck until i get the files from my avatar creator?
title: Avatar Broken. Seats Bug?
